The '''Raceway Line''' was a [[commutube]] line in [[Umgul City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umgul/Legends|Umgul]]. It was a branch of the [[Katsu Line]] and connected the city to the [[Fondine Blob Raceways]].
